name: blur-vignette-video
blurb: Video with a blur vignette edge fade that softens the frame border.
description: Plays a looping, muted video with a CSS blur vignette overlay that fades edges to transparent. Scales on hover. Built on BlurVignette context wrapper.
use_when: Background or decorative video where soft edge fading feels more refined than hard borders.
avoid_when: Interactive videos or when the vignette blur itself should be customizable per instance.
a11y: Video is muted and autoplays. No controls or captions. Purely decorative.
